kurz: Too much water or too much loose starch, sometimes also too much stirring.
bild_im_kopf: Like marbles that have fallen into glue: instead of rolling separately, they all stick together.

ursachen.warum: The grain swells too far and bursts open.
fix: Measure the water, e.g. about 1.5 parts water to 1 part long-grain rice (as a guide)

ursachen.warum: Loose starch on the surface makes it sticky.
fix: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear

ursachen.warum: Stirring releases starch, as with risotto.
fix: Rest after cooking, then fluff up

q2.frage: Did you rinse the rice first?
